headline: Pawtucket High School construction contract awards to Shawmut Design & Construction and a state school construction funding application.
summary: The meeting will cover a state school construction funding application for Pawtucket High School. It will also consider recommendations to award seven Pawtucket High School work packages to Shawmut Design & Construction.
items: Authorize execution and submission of a Necessity of School Construction Stage I Application to the RIDE School Building Authority
Recommendation to award #029, Pawtucket High School Scaffolding Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #030, Pawtucket High School Roofing Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #031, Pawtucket High School Drywall Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #032, Pawtucket High School Fireproofing Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #033, Pawtucket High School Doors, Frames and Hardware Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #034, Pawtucket High School Food Equipment and Appliances Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
Recommendation to award #035, Pawtucket High School Unit Masonry Package, to Shawmut Design & Construction
location: Joseph Jenks Junior High School, 350 Division Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860
